compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.desc: Reduce PDF file size without losing quality. Compress PDF files up to 90% smaller, right in your browser.

steps.name: Upload your PDF
steps.text: Drag and drop your PDF file into the upload area, or click to browse and select your file. Files up to 50MB are supported.

steps.name: Adjust compression level
steps.text: Choose your preferred compression level. "Balanced" is recommended for the best quality/size tradeoff.

steps.name: Download the compressed file
steps.text: Your compressed PDF is ready instantly. Click Download to save it to your device — completely free, no watermarks.

faqs.a: Yes. Our compression algorithm intelligently reduces image quality and removes redundant data while preserving text, vector graphics, and document structure. You can choose between three compression modes.

faqs.q: How much can I reduce a PDF file size?
faqs.a: Most PDFs can be compressed by 70-90% depending on content. Text-only PDFs compress the most, while image-heavy PDFs may compress less. A 10MB PDF typically reduces to 1-3MB.

faqs.q: Is it safe to upload my PDF?
faqs.a: Yes! Files are processed entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Your PDF never leaves your device, so you can safely compress sensitive documents like contracts, invoices, and resumes.

merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.desc: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document. Merge PDFs instantly in your browser. No sign-up, no watermarks.

steps.name: Upload multiple PDFs
steps.text: Drag and drop multiple PDF files into the upload area, or click to browse and select files. You can add up to 20 PDFs at once.

steps.name: Arrange order
steps.text: Drag files to reorder them. The top file will appear first in your merged document.

steps.name: Download merged PDF
steps.text: Click "Merge PDFs" to combine them, then download your single merged document instantly.

faqs.a: No, you must first remove the password protection using our Remove PDF Password tool, then merge the unlocked files.

faqs.q: Is there a limit to how many PDFs I can merge?
faqs.a: You can merge up to 20 PDF files at once, with a combined total size of 100MB. For larger batches, consider Adobe Acrobat Pro.

split.title: Split PDF
split.desc: Separate a PDF into individual pages or extract specific page ranges. Split PDF files instantly in your browser. No sign-up required.

steps.name: Upload your PDF
steps.text: Drag and drop your PDF file into the upload area. Files up to 50MB are supported.

steps.name: Choose split mode
steps.text: Select "Split All Pages" to separate every page, or "Extract Range" to split specific pages.

steps.name: Download split files
steps.text: Download individual pages as separate PDFs, or download everything as a ZIP file.

faqs.a: PDF splitting separates a multi-page PDF document into individual pages or smaller documents. This is useful for extracting specific content, reducing file sizes for email, or organizing large documents into manageable sections.
